products.name: Handmade Damascus Steel Knives
products.tagline: Hand-forged blades, hardwood handles — no two alike
products.description: Full-tang fixed-blade knives with a hand-forged Damascus steel blade — that rippling, layered pattern is real folded steel, not an etched finish. Each one ships in a branded gift box with a genuine leather belt sheath. The handle scales are cut from dyed hardwood, so every knife has its own one-of-a-kind color pattern — the one you receive won't be identical to the ones pictured here. Works great as a kitchen or camp knife, or just as a display piece.
products.note: Carbon steel blade — hand wash and oil lightly after use to keep it from rusting. Limited stock from a liquidation lot; once a handle pattern is gone, it's gone.

products.name: Compact Folding Pocket Knives
products.tagline: Everyday-carry folder with a keychain clip
products.description: Small folding pocket knives in matte black or brushed silver, with a built-in keychain clip and a finger-hole opening. Light enough to carry every day and sized for small jobs — opening boxes, cutting twine, that kind of thing.
products.note: Sold individually — mention a color preference (black or silver) when you reach out.

products.name: NESTI CASA Reed Diffuser Sets
products.description: Full-size NESTI CASA reed diffuser sets (Brooklyn, NY) — a scent bottle in a matte ceramic vessel with a full set of reed sticks, new and sealed in box. Available in Amber Sandalwood, Romantic Lavender, and Jasmine Maojin.
products.note: These are overstock/liquidation units — factory sealed, just priced to move. Mention a scent preference when you reach out; availability varies by scent.

products.name: Ceramic Diffuser Vessels — Blank or Custom Engraved
products.tagline: Same vessel, bare or laser-engraved to order
products.description: The same matte ceramic diffuser vessel as the NESTI CASA sets, sold on its own — no scent oil included, for refilling your own or just displaying reeds. I also do custom laser engraving on these; the floral pattern shown is an example of what's possible, not a standard finish.
products.note: Want a custom design, initials, or a name engraved on one? Reach out and describe what you have in mind.
